description: One company's LinkedIn page as JSON: description, website, industry, size and employee count, followers, founding year, specialities, offices and where its staff are based. Use it when: You are researching a company, qualifying a lead or checking a supplier and want its official LinkedIn facts. Not for: People: names of employees, profiles or email addresses are not returned. Returns: Name, tagline, description, website, phone, industry, company type, employee count and range, followers, founded year, specialities, office addresses and staff counts by location and job function. Typical time: about 9 s. Price: $0.007 per company, charged only on success. One call = one company's LinkedIn profile.

company.description: Company name or its LinkedIn company URL, e.g. Stripe or https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe
